verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider that holds sensitive client data and offers status dashboards, so a buyer could fairly ask where that data is stored; the axis applies. The pack only makes a generic claim of 'protected data security', which is a related control rather than a choice of storage region. The 'home residency requirement' item concerns J-1 visa rules and has nothing to do with data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
